style.backgroundSystem: two linked systems held to one material language: a real warm home corner (plaster wall #9CBE55 with a pleated fabric drape #E8A887 at one side, oak plank floor #D9A85E, one round pedestal #DDBE86 with a hairline rim) for hero and closing screens, and flat mint #EAF3DC or grass-green #86AB3F infographic screens carrying rounded cards #FFFFFF with 24px corner radius and solid green label bands
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line circular icons in #5E8A28 inside plain circles, small solid round pictogram tokens, numbered green capsule chips, folded corner flags on table headers, rounded card grids with one solid label band under each image, hairline rules in #5E8A28; no medical crosses, no organ diagrams, no authenticity seals
style.lightingSystem: soft warm daylight key from the upper left at 5200K through the drape, long soft leaf shadows on the wall, grounded contact shadows so nothing floats; flat even high-key light at 5600K with soft short shadows on all infographic screens
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet-care home-studio ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of grass-green panel #86AB3F, mint field #EAF3DC and card field #FFFFFF with plaster wall #9CBE55, pleated drape #E8A887, oak plank floor #D9A85E and round pedestal #DDBE86, one deep green text color #5E8A28 and one soft pink accent #D98FB4; warm-neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif Chinese typography with one headline weight per screen, a kicker line above each headline, headlines in #FFFFFF on green fields and in #5E8A28 on light fields; background system alternating a real warm home corner (plaster wall #9CBE55 with a pleated drape #E8A887, oak plank floor #D9A85E, one round pedestal #DDBE86 with a hairline rim) and flat mint #EAF3DC or grass-green #86AB3F infographic screens carrying rounded cards #FFFFFF with 24px corner radius and solid green label bands; soft warm daylight key from the upper left at 5200K through the drape with long soft leaf shadows and grounded contact shadows, flat even high-key light at 5600K on infographic screens; single-family thin-line circular icons in #5E8A28 with solid round pictogram tokens, numbered capsule chips, folded corner table flags and card grids with solid label bands; the upright ribbed-cap bottle held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale on every screen with cap, thread neck and label print true to the reference, contents shown as generic unprinted tablet discs, the cat always cropped or turned so no individual animal identity dominates; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes or membership or store stickers, no approval or serial numbers, no fabricated certifications.
noDrift: no QR codes, membership stickers or store badges
no approval numbers, serial codes or lot numbers
no fabricated certifications, lab data or efficacy figures
no numeric weights, ages or tablet counts in rendered copy
style.presentationRules: the upright bottle with its ribbed screw cap is held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, grounded by a soft contact shadow, its cap knurling, thread neck and wrap-around label true to the reference and never restyled; contents read as generic unprinted tablet discs and are never counted into a numeric dose; the cat is always cropped or turned so no individual animal identity dominates
style.surfaceSystem: oak plank floor #D9A85E, round pedestal #DDBE86 with hairline rim, matte mint panel #EAF3DC, glossy ceramic dish #FFFFFF
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif Chinese, one headline weight per screen; headlines in #FFFFFF on green fields and in #5E8A28 on light fields, kicker line 18pt above the headline, sub-labels and band captions 14-20pt; every rendered line is carried as a placeholder, never as source copy
